properties.description: This detection identifies both interactive and non-interactive sign-ins within Microsoft Entra ID over the past 1 hour that are associated with critical first-party Microsoft applications, including Microsoft Graph and Azure Active Directory. The query focuses on specific AppId and ResourceIdentity combinations to surface authentication events that may indicate potential compromise, unauthorized access, or suspicious service principal activity
properties.query:
let QueryPeriod = 1h;
let InteractiveSignin =
SigninLogs 
| where TimeGenerated > ago(QueryPeriod)
| where (AppId == "1b730954-1685-4b74-9bfd-dac224a7b894" and
ResourceIdentity == "00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000") or 
(AppId == "04b07795-8ddb-461a-bbee-02f9e1bf7b46" and
ResourceIdentity == "00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000");
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(QueryPeriod)
| where (AppId == "eb20f3e3-3dce-4d2c-b721-ebb8d4414067" and
ResourceIdentity == "00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000") or 
(AppId == "04b07795-8ddb-461a-bbee-02f9e1bf7b46" and
ResourceIdentity == "797f4846-ba00-4fd7-ba43-dac1f8f63013")
| union InteractiveSignin
